buildCommand: curl -o flutter.tar.xz https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases/stable/linux/flutter_linux_3.19.6-stable.tar.xz && tar xf flutter.tar.xz && export PATH="$PATH:`pwd`/flutter/bin" && flutter precache --web && flutter build web --release --dart-define=OPENAI_API_KEY=$OPENAI_API_KEY --dart-define=SUPABASE_URL=$SUPABASE_URL --dart-define=SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=$SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
